actions.action: Enforce five-minute expiry and explicit eviction.
actions.mechanism: Expiration determines freshness; capacity eviction never extends a record’s lifetime.
actions.implementation: Store a monotonic expiry deadline no later than five minutes after fetching starts. Remove expired records on access and with a scheduled sweep. Before admitting a record, remove expired entries, then evict the least recently used entry if necessary. Never return an expired entry as fresh.
actions.check: With a fake clock, verify a record is unavailable at its deadline. Insert 101 distinct records and verify capacity eviction and unchanged deadlines.
actions.risk: Strict expiry reduces availability during source outages.

actions.action: Make source timeouts and outages explicit.
actions.mechanism: A bounded fetch deadline and circuit breaker prevent indefinite waits and repeated calls to an unavailable source.
actions.implementation: Set a configurable source timeout. On timeout, return HTTP 503 with a machine-readable source_timeout code; do not cache the error or extend expiry. After a configured failure threshold, temporarily stop source calls and permit one recovery probe. Continue serving unexpired cached records; keep normal expiry and eviction active.
actions.check: Simulate a hanging source. Verify bounded responses, breaker activation, continued expiry, and recovery after a successful probe.
actions.risk: Breaker settings can delay recovery or reject requests during brief failures.

actions.action: Bound concurrent fetches as well as cached records.
actions.mechanism: Shared requests and admission reservations prevent concurrent misses from exceeding the 100-record memory limit.
actions.implementation: Coalesce misses for the same key into one fetch. Under one lock, require cached records plus reserved incoming-record slots to remain at most 100. Evict or reject admission before decoding a new record. Bound waiting requests, release reservations on every failure, and disable response-body retention in diagnostics.
actions.check: Run concurrent distinct-key misses and duplicate-key misses against a delayed source. Assert the slot invariant, one fetch per duplicate key, and no leaked reservations after cancellation.
actions.risk: Admission rejection or eviction can increase misses under bursts.

actions.action: Admit only explicitly public record fields.
actions.mechanism: A public-only source contract and field allowlist prevent accidental private-data caching.
actions.implementation: Use a source endpoint restricted to public records, validate its public-record designation, and cache only approved fields. Reject unknown fields or visibility states without logging payloads. Keep source identifiers for later refetching rather than retaining full source responses.
actions.check: Supply fixtures with private visibility, missing visibility, and unexpected fields. Verify rejection and absence of those payloads from cache, logs, and error responses.
actions.risk: An allowlist cannot make an incorrectly classified source trustworthy; schema changes may cause valid records to be rejected.
